propositions: The transition lib param `force: bool, force_close: str | None` must be unified to `force: str | None` matching the claim shape, where the string value carries the audit reason and None indicates no force.

The transition CLI and all guidance strings must normalize to the universal `--force[=<reason>]` pattern with no fallback to `--reason` for the force note, and bare `--force` must expand to `(no reason given)` identically to claim.
Legacy calls `rebar.transition(force_close="<r>")` and `rebar.transition(force=True)` must warn via _deprecations and map to the new `force` string shape without behavior change.
The in-memory force-reason concept must be spelled uniformly as `force_reason` across transition and claim internals, while the persisted status_data key `force_close_reason` is retained unchanged.
Empty-string force (`force=""`) must not bypass; only None (absent) or non-empty strings (present reason) drive bypass, and canonical explicit `force` input wins over deprecated-alias spellings.
Automated NDJSON import must omit force on close to preserve target close-gate policy and pre-unification behavior, avoiding accidental completion-verify bypass.
